description:
Comprehensive phased redevelopment including demolition
of all existing structures/buildings and construction of a mixed-use
development comprising residential units and residential concierge (Use Class
C3), replacement retail food store (Use Class E), new flexible commercial unit
(Use Class E), public realm improvements, hard and soft landscaping, children’s
play space,  customer and residential car parking (including new basement
level), temporary decked car park, cycle storage, revised access and servicing
arrangements, refuse storage, rooftop plant and photovoltaic/solar plant and
associated works and enabling works incidental to the proposed development.  (This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement)  Further explanation (not forming part of the formal description of development
set out above): The proposed phased, mixed-use redevelopment comprises the
following demolition of all existing structures and buildings, site preparation
and enabling works, replacement store and additional retail unit, and 480
residential units in total (Use Class C3) (36% being affordable units), in the
following in two phases:   [Phase 1] Construction of replacement new Tesco
store at ground and first floors with sales floor area of 3,814sqm (Use Class
E); relocation of entrance to corner of Station Road and Hindes Road with
ancillary kiosk, new commercial unit fronting Hindes Road of 53.3sqm (Use Class
E); 213 residential units (153 affordable housing units) (Class C3) above the
new store in blocks ranging in height from 7 to 13 storeys. Basement level
residential car-parking (67 spaces) and Ground floor commercial parking (159
spaces) and external parking to the west (83 spaces); Temporary deck car park
(during delivery of Phase 1); External amenity including at landscaped podium
level for residents and children’s play space (763sqm).   [Phase 2]
Demolition of existing Tesco store (following completion of new store);
deconstruction of temporary deck parking; new residential units (267 private
sale units) ranging in height from 4 to 13 storeys; Residential undercroft
parking (47 spaces) and external parking (28 spaces); External amenity
including at landscaped podium level for residents and children’s play space
(1,327sqm).   Across the development 890 cycle parking spaces, 242
commercial car-parking spaces 142 residential car-parking spaces, 2,090sqm of
children’s and a publicly accessible central square and new pedestrian and
cycle routes through the site are proposed. (AMENDED PLANS RECEIVED)
